description: This file contains C++ source code implementing classes, methods, and enums related to metadata management within the Thunder namespace, including service states, channels, subsystems, and server information.

classes.name: Metadata::Service::State
classes.description: Represents the state of a service, with JSON serialization and operator overloads.

classes.name: Metadata::Service
classes.description: Encapsulates service configuration, versioning, and statistics.

classes.name: Metadata::Channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel with remote, state, activity, id, and name fields.

classes.name: Metadata::Server::Minion
classes.description: Represents a minion in the server's thread pool with id, job, and run count.

classes.name: Metadata::Server
classes.description: Contains thread pool and pending request information.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Main class aggregating subsystems, plugins, channels, bridges, process info, values, and version.

classes.name: Metadata::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystems with add and copy constructors.
